mechanism.claim: A volatile completed BTC block that spends an unusually large fraction of its minutes strictly on one side of its initial auction price reflects persistent directional acceptance rather than a terminal jump. Follow the occupied side for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of minutes above minus minutes below the first minute open
mechanism.why_distinct: Return-sign persistence counts incremental directions; median breadth summarizes bar returns; close location uses terminal position inside a range; path efficiency uses displacement divided by travel; median-shift compares two return halves. HVPLO measures time occupation of a fixed initial price level across the whole block and uses no volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, endpoint gate, prior event, fitted outcome, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed realized variation must be in its causal upper 35% while absolute signed level occupation enters its upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily fixed-level occupation onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.reference_level: open of the first completed minute in the block, finite strict positive
features.above_count: number of minute closes strictly above reference_level
features.below_count: number of minute closes strictly below reference_level
features.level_occupation: (above_count-below_count)/(above_count+below_count), finite strict nonzero denominator and contrast
features.occupation_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(level_occupation) over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared minute returns), finite strict positive
features.eligible_state: occupation and variation gates pass with level_occupation strict nonzero
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: fixed-level path occupation during elevated variation

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no reference level, occupation formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
